parole.significato: ice skate, skate (boot with a blade attached to the bottom)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Slovak korčola, from Hungarian korcsolya (“ice skate”), from Italian chiocciola (“snail”), from Latin cochlea (“snail”), from Ancient Greek κοχλíας (kokhlías, “snail”), from Ancient Greek κóχλος (kókhlos, “snail”). First attested in the 19th century.
